title: eng-ml
text:
eng-ml

eval-bot: NIGHTLY_EVAL: model=redwood-1.1-q8 prompt_set=customer_support failure_rate=18% (+11% vs baseline redwood-1.1-fp16). Most diffs clustered around staging prompts 12-18. Logs: https://ci.redwood/exec/4599 :warning:
Alex H: did anything change to sampling config or seeding for last night's run? cc @Maya P
Maya P: i tweaked the quant profile for q8 experiments and also adjusted default sampling top_p (0.95 -> 0.92). i also forgot to pin the seed for nightly job — it used None. sorry. :grimacing:
Samir: that could definitely blow up variance. seed None + top_p change explains some of it, but +11% is still large.
Maya P: also swapped RNG to use torch.Generator(device='cuda') for speed; device rng may not be deterministic across kernels for q8.
Jon R: can you paste the exact eval command that ran?
Maya P: sure:
```
python tools/nightly_eval.py --model redwood-1.1-q8 \\n  --prompt-set customer_support --batch-size 16 \\n  --seed None --sampling '{"temperature":0.8,"top_p":0.92,"top_k":40}'
```
Alex H: seed=None -> random each run. we need a rerun with a fixed seed and with top_p at the previous 0.95 to check.
Maya P: queued a rerun with seed=42 and top_p=0.95 (job 4621). ETA ~45m.
eval-bot: Job 4621 started: https://ci.redwood/exec/4621
Samir: also add a comparison run with fp16 variant. quant kernels (q8) sometimes introduce extra stochasticity in approx_softmax paths. compare redwood-1.1-fp16 to isolate quant effects.
Alex H: good call — add redwood-1.1-fp16 as baseline in the rerun.
Maya P: added both reruns. will post quick diffs when they finish. if regression persists, we should glance at runtime sampling code.
Jon R: FYI i saw a recent change in runtime: commit 1a2b3c updated Sampler::sample_topk tie-breaking to use rng.uniform() differently. @Alex H can you take a look?
Alex H: on it. quick grep shows that commit changed tie-breaker order for equal scores — could alter outputs for top_k small values. reverting for a test is trivial.
Maya P: thx. if we revert runtime change we still need to ensure sampling config is stable for evals.
eval-bot: Job 4621 finished. Summary: redwood-1.1-q8 (seed=42, top_p=0.95) failure_rate=7%. redwood-1.1-fp16 (seed=42) failure_rate=6.5%. Diffs now within expected noise. Looks like config/seed drift was main culprit.
Samir: closing as config drift + seed propagation bug. we should add safeguards.
Alex H: agreed. i'll add CI gate: nightly runner must pin --seed and persist sampling config in job metadata/logs. also add an alert if sampling params differ from baseline config.
Maya P: created issue #884: pin seeds + log sampling params. pushed patch to nightly_eval to fail when --seed is None. :white_check_mark:
Jon R: can we also add a small check that warns when top_p/top_k differ from the model's quant-tuned profile? dashboard metric maybe.
Alex H: yes — open a follow-up for ops. tagging for visibility. :eyes:
